cause.summary: Our prior on lambda (SD 0.025) does not hold lambda at 0.25: its posterior mean is 0.34, and alpha (357) moves with it. kappa+ comes within 1% of Fig. 1H, the other three parameters within 7%.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The informative prior on lambda was much tighter than ours
hypotheses.test: Joint gC/gD fit with SD 0.0025: the posterior-mean error is 7.2% (output/sensitivity.json), close to the paper's 6.8%. This is a test of the cause, not our result.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Our branches mix fates
hypotheses.test: Our low-dimensional clustering errors are 17 to 21% (supp. Table 1 gives 7 to 9%); moving the early-cell threshold to 200 gives 13.9% (output/sensitivity.json).
